finalResult.currentParagraphText: “That we shouldn’t try to forcefully drag them into our world more than they already are,” Jake muttered.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: Caleb nodded. “Doing so would only make them miserable. Instead, allow them to at least help in their own way. Let them be a place you can return to when you want some peace and quiet. An escape from our world, if you will.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Jake... D-grade or C-grade, the difference in lifespan is marginal compared to an S-grade, much less a god. They also know that. Mom and Dad aren’t under any illusion that they’ll outlive either of us, and truthfully, I don’t think they’d want to. They are already more than pleased with how long they’ll be able to live now... in fact, I heard Mom talking about it, almost feeling like too long. Do you understand what I mean?”
